tasks.memory_basis: Six16CPU immediate-refill queue. Only genuine accepted final geometry may release each macro. Full-GDS escape forecast S96GiB/V128GiB/R128GiB is conservative, not a measured peak; output STA64GiB each. Admission1.2 margin plus16GiB guard and liveRSS may reduce six-way concurrency when sums exceed actual RAM. No repeat of passed M/T/P&R/gates. Staged only; no allocation before at least one geometry receipt is PASSED.
